title: Economic Returns from Government Grants Provided for Taylor Swift's Eras Tour Concerts in Singapore
what_it_is: Economic Returns from Government Grants Provided for Taylor Swift's Eras Tour Concerts in Singapore

sections.label: Concert economic value-add questions
sections.summary: Questions ask about economic value-add from Taylor Swift's Eras Tour and from concerts in Singapore in the first half of 2024, and about targets and strategies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) what is the total economic value-add expected from Taylor Swift's The Eras Tour concerts in Singapore; and (b) how were the size and conditionality of the grant offered by the Government to bring the tour to Singapore determined.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) what is the total economic value-add expected from concerts held in Singapore in the first half of 2024; (b) whether the Ministry has set a target for the total economic value-add derived from hosting concerts in Singapore for the full year; (c) if so, whether the Ministry expects to be on track to achieve the full-year target; and (d) what are the Ministry's strategies to remain on track to achieve its target amidst intense regional competition.

sections.label: Sports Hub event day increase
sections.summary: The Sports Hub has seen a 30% increase in sports, entertainment, and community and lifestyle event days since the Government takeover, compared to the best number before COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Since we took over, the Sports Hub has seen a 30% increase in sports, entertainment, and community and lifestyle event days since the Government takeover, compared to the best number of event days prior to the COVID-19 pandemic.

sections.label: Grant size and confidentiality
sections.summary: Online speculation on the grant size is inaccurate and not as high as speculated, but business confidentiality prevents revealing the grant's size or conditions; economic benefits are assessed to outweigh the grant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: There has been some online speculation as to the size of the grant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: I can say that it is not accurate and not anywhere as high as speculated but due to business confidentiality reasons, we cannot reveal the specific size of the grant or the conditions of the grant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: However, I can assure Members of the House that the economic benefits to Singapore are assessed to be significant and outweigh the size of the grant.

sections.label: Tickets for lower-income beneficiaries
sections.summary: For some concerts including Coldplay and Taylor Swift, KASM retains tickets and works with SportCares, SG Cares Volunteer Centres, SouthEast Community Development Centre and other organisations to give tickets to beneficiaries and volunteers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: To Mr Xie Yao Quan's specific question, for some concerts including high demand ones like Coldplay and Taylor Swift, KASM retains some tickets and works with SportCares, which is SportSG's charity and philanthropic arm, SG Cares Volunteer Centres, SouthEast Community Development Centre and other organisations to give tickets to beneficiaries from lower-income families or at-risk families, as well as volunteers from these organisations, so that they too can be a part of the Sports Hub experience.

sections.label: National School Games finals event days
sections.summary: Sports Hub hosted a record 43 National School Games Finals event days in FY2023, more than twice the 16 NSG finals event days before COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: For example, Sports Hub had hosted a record 43 National School Games (NSG) Finals event days in FY2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: That is more than twice the number of 16 NSG finals event days before COVID-19, which stood at 60.

sections.label: Local musicians in Taylor Swift deal
sections.summary: A question asks whether the terms and conditions of the deal bringing Taylor Swift to Singapore exclusively with Government grants had the potential to include involvement and profiling of local musicians.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: First of all, as part of the terms and conditions of the deal that was struck to bring Taylor Swift to Singapore exclusively with the support of Government grants, was there the potential to include the involvement and profiling of local musicians?

sections.label: Exclusivity clauses and confidentiality questions
sections.summary: The passage asks whether confidentiality clauses about exclusivity arrangements were in the contracts and whether those terms were breached.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: As we have seen in the news, the exclusivity clauses have struck a nerve with some of our neighbouring countries and caused some amount of tension.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: So, my questions are these: were confidentiality clauses about the exclusivity arrangements built into the contracts and if they were, were these terms breached?

sections.label: Confidentiality agreement and assessment
sections.summary: The passage states there is a confidentiality agreement, that its terms will be assessed, and that appropriate measures will be taken under advisement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: On the second point, yes, there is a confidentiality agreement and we will assess the terms, and we will take the appropriate measures under advisement.

sections.label: Examples of performers
sections.summary: The passage names Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Jackie Cheung and Taylor Swift as some examples.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Jackie Cheung and Taylor Swift, being some examples.

sections.label: Duration considerations for Taylor Swift
sections.summary: The passage states that past tour history and setup made one or two nights difficult, so duration was a material consideration in discussions with the Taylor Swift team.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In this case, we were mindful that if we looked at it holistically, if we wanted an opportunity for Singapore to be one of the stops, and then you look at the past tour history, it is very difficult to be one or two nights alone because of the setup.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, we had to look at that as quite a material consideration for discussing with the Taylor Swift team on how long and for what duration to host it in Singapore.
